metadata.title: Raw data for: Association between peripheral refraction, axial elongation, and myopia progression in children wearing DIMS lenses over 36 months
metadata.description: This dataset contains anonymised raw data supporting the findings of the study on peripheral refraction, axial elongation, and myopia progression in children wearing DIMS spectacle lenses over a 36-month follow-up period. Variables include spherical equivalent refraction, relative peripheral refraction, and axial length measured at predefined time points.
